harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (RHEL 9.8): SSH open to any source, TCP/9000 accepted only from node2 (10.100.66.11) via a rich rule, and TCP/9000 rejected from all other sources (including node3) via a lower-priority reject rich rule. Rules were added --permanent and reloaded, confirmed identical in runtime and permanent config, and firewalld is enabled at boot. Verified functionally: node2→node1:9000 connects and receives data; node3→node1:9000 gets ECONNREFUSED (REJECT); node3→node1:22 connects (SSH open to any address). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id baselines, issued native systemd reboots that acknowledged before disconnecting, polled until reachable again, confirmed each boot_id changed, and re-verified post-reboot health — node1's firewalld rules persisted through its own reboot and the accept/reject behavior was re-tested and matched pre-reboot results; node2 and node3 came back with active sshd and changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/firewall baseline (RHEL 9.8, firewalld active, ssh already allowed)
Resolved node2/node3 IPs via $CLUSTER_HOSTS (node2=10.100.66.11, node3=10.100.66.12)
Added permanent firewalld rich rule accepting tcp/9000 from node2's IP
Added permanent firewalld rich rule (priority 100) rejecting tcp/9000 from any source
Ensured ssh service remains enabled in the public zone (allows SSH from any address)
Reloaded firewalld and confirmed runtime config matches permanent config
Started a socat listener on node1:9000 to functionally test the rules
Verified node2 can connect to node1:9000 (ACCEPT) and node3 cannot (ECONNREFUSED/REJECT)
Verified node3 can reach node1:22 (SSH open to any address)
Captured boot_id and health baselines for node1, node2, node3
Restarted node1, node2, node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot
Polled each node until reachable and confirmed changed boot_id post-restart
Re-verified firewalld rules persisted on node1 after reboot and re-tested accept/reject behavior from node2/node3
Confirmed sshd active and firewalld enabled+active after restarts

evidence.requirement: SSH allowed from any address on node1
evidence.summary: Baseline showed ssh service already permitted in public zone; permanent config re-confirmed after rule changes; node3 (arbitrary source) successfully connected to node1:22 and received SSH banner.

evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 allowed only from node2, persistent config
evidence.summary: Added permanent rich rule accepting tcp/9000 from 10.100.66.11 (node2), reloaded firewalld, confirmed runtime=permanent config, started test listener, and node2 successfully connected and received listener output.

evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else
evidence.summary: Added permanent priority-100 rich rule rejecting tcp/9000 from any source; node3's connection attempt to node1:9000 returned ConnectionRefusedError (REJECT), confirming enforcement.

firewalld target/permanent config captured pre-reboot; node1 boot_id changed from 6bb7e004... to e01eb2be... after restart; post-reboot firewall-cmd --list-all shows identical rich rules; node2 accept and node3 reject behavior re-confirmed after node1's reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence (baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery)
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 6bb7e004...; issued systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect, confirmed by subsequent connection reset/timeout); polled until reachable with new boot_id e01eb2be...; verified firewalld active with persisted rules and re-tested accept/reject connectivity.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart evidence (baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery)
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 98aa35f5...; issued systemctl reboot; polled until reachable with new boot_id 3757c673...; confirmed sshd active and node2 could still reach node1:9000 (functional recovery).

evidence.requirement: node3 restart evidence (baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery)
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id f1afbc7f...; issued systemctl reboot; polled until reachable with new boot_id 8aee57c1...; confirmed sshd active and node3's connection to node1:9000 still correctly rejected (functional recovery of the reject rule).
